text:
mira: Quick check — the new right-rail knowledge card links to a bunch of docs pages but the microcopy uses 'Help panel' in some places and 'In-app docs' in others. Could cause confusion in copy + cross-links. Should we pick one term?

dan: Good catch. I saw mixed usage too. My vote is to standardize on 'In-product docs' (matches research), but open to bikeshedding. Also want to confirm: when someone clicks a glossary term in the card, should we open an in-rail anchor or navigate to the full docs page? Current behavior navigates away.

jess: Accessibility nit: links inside the collapsed card aren't keyboard-focusable until expanded, and the contrast on the link color is borderline. We should add tabindex management and bump contrast to AA.

toni: Strong +1 on in-rail anchor for definitions. Users lose context when we jump them to a new tab. If anchor missing, fallback to the full page. Also, we should avoid opening external guides in the same tab.

sam: From product interviews: users liked 'Learn more' CTAs more than generic 'Docs' labels. So microcopy suggestion: use 'In-product docs' as canonical name and 'Learn more' on CTAs. Keep anchors for quick lookups.

mira: microcopy options (quick):
```
A) In-product docs — Learn more
B) In-app help — Read more
C) Documentation — Open guide
```
Which do we prefer?

jess: A + accessibility fixes. I'll open a small PR to add proper aria-expanded/aria-controls and tabindex for the anchor list.

dan: I'll wire up the routing to return anchors when available and emit an analytics event `help_card_open` + `help_card_anchor_click`. Also will add a mapping table for doc slugs -> in-rail anchors so redirects are consistent.

docs-bot: Link audit result: 3 failing anchors found in the current build — `/docs/opt#kv-cache`, `/docs/serve#prefetch`, `/docs/console#routes`. Recommend creating stable anchor IDs before rollout.

toni: can we also add a visual affordance for links that open new tabs (icon + `rel="noopener"`)? a11y guidance says we should inform keyboard users.

mira: perfect. Action items: jess -> PR for a11y + contrast; dan -> routing + analytics; mira -> copy sweep (pick option A) and update figma (https://figma.com/file/abcd1234). I'll tag @design and @docs for final signoff. :thumbsup:

sam: timeline? can we aim for a small patch next sprint so Dedicated customers see consistent behavior in the next release?

mira: yes — target PRs by EOD Fri, review early next week. Thanks everyone.
